name: caltech_birds2011
description: Caltech-UCSD Birds 2011 (CUB-2011) is a fine-grained computer vision dataset containing images of 200 bird species used to evaluate species classification and related tasks (e.g., part localization, attribute prediction). It measures a model's ability to distinguish visually similar classes and to localize discriminative parts. The dataset is commonly used to benchmark fine-grained recognition methods and representation learning approaches.
reputation: Long-standing, widely used benchmark in fine-grained visual recognition research.
